==Quest information==
===Requirements===
*This quest is only offered to [[level]] 20 [[character]]s.

===Objectives===
*Win a battle in the [[Codex Arena]].
*See Zenjal <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen Order|Zaishen]] Guide] for your reward.

===Reward===
*5,000 [[Experience]]
* [[Strategist's Zaishen Strongbox]]

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Zenjal [Zaishen Guide]
:''"Impressively fought. However, in the ever-changing Codex Arena, victory is never assured. Show me that you have the skill and wits to win!"''
{{Offer dialog
| accept = I'm ready!
| decline = Let me check my skills first...
}}

===Intermediate dialogue ===
;Zenjal [Zaishen Guide]
:''"To compete in the Codex Arena, you must journey to the Battle Isles. If you wish, I can send you directly to [[Codex Arena (outpost)|the staging area]]. Is your heart prepared for the flames of battle?"''
{{Offer dialog
| accept = Let's do it.
| decline = Not now.
}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Zenjal [Zaishen Guide]
:''"I can see that, even handicapped, you are a formidable fighter and worthy of the Zaishen. Tell me: what battles will you seek next?"''
